title: What tactics will Burnham use to sell his EU plans? – podcast
summary_full: Andy Burnham has set out his plans to win parliamentary backing for a new EU deal. But the various options for how Britain could rejoin the EU, or ‘Breturn’, will not be outlined until December. Pippa Crerar has been speaking to the prime minister about how he hopes to convince the public that reversing Brexit is worth the headacheYou can tell us what you think of Guardian podcasts with our survey hereSend any questions for Pippa and Kiran to politicsweeklyuk@theguardian.comYou can watch this episode of Politics Weekly on our YouTube channel here.
